findings.highlight: don’t ever say you’ll take the Shroud off
findings.evidenceJa: 聖骸布を外そうなんて決して思わないで
findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou never even to think of removing the Shroud.
findings.explanation: The English relocates Rin’s absolute prohibition from Shirou’s intention to his speech, materially weakening the safety rule governing Archer’s arm.
